fields.gap: The wrinkling target uses the advisory one-half cube-root formula. The equal Ec and Gc square root is not used as a result.
fields.direction: MAINLINE-007b cites a sourced wrinkling formula and keeps Ec and Gc separate.
fields.effect: Catalog foams and aramid honeycomb miss this product by about 40 to 180 times. Aluminium honeycomb has no retrieved Ec, so its product is open.
